subject: Northleaf Diagnostics: implementation cadence & concierge nomination
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Carolyn Reid <carolyn@northleafdx.com>, Mike Hughes <mike.hughes@northleafdx.com>, procurement@northleafdx.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Northleaf Diagnostics: implementation cadence & concierge nomination

Team — quick handoff note for Northleaf (deal ND-DL-9821). Summary first, then asks.

Deal at a glance:
- Product: Redwood Dedicated (reserved GPU pool) + embeddings + structured search endpoint.
- Committed: 3x A100 equivalent nodes (monthly committed plan) — 12-month term.
- Target go-live: 2027-01-31 (customer wants end-of-January).
- Key scope: SSO (SAML), US data residency, Vault KMS integration for keys, EMR connector for document ingestion, embeddings tuning for clinical notes.

Attached: ND-MAP-vFinal.pdf (mutual action plan), SOW-Northleaf-v1.docx (scope & acceptance), network-requirements.png.

Known open items / risks:
1) Legal: their counsel returned a handful of redlines; Ben is coordinating (expect final back by ~2026-12-10).
2) Network: customer will need a dedicated egress IP range and a small VPC peering window; ops will need the diagram attached.
3) Data: they require HSM-backed KMS and an audit trail for embeddings storage — internal security checklist called out below.

Recommendation & asks:
- Primary CS lead: Monica Patel (recommended). Monica, please confirm you can accept primary concierge for this account.
- Technical lead: Tessa Morgan (recommended) — point for SSO and EMR ingestion.
- Commercial/ops: Ben will remain on-loop for contract/procurement questions and billing cadence.

Next steps (short):
- Monica / Tessa: propose two 60-min kickoff windows next week (Dec 6–10) for discovery + tech intake.
- Monica: run through the pre-kickoff intake (I attached the MAP; please convert to checklist).
- Ben: confirm whether we need a PO before we schedule any account provisioning.
- Carolyn / Mike (Northleaf): please confirm the technical contact and preferred kickoff windows.

Thanks — I'll be available during the week to join the kickoff for the first 20 minutes to ensure a smooth strip-in.

Jonas Weber
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com
+1 (415) 555-0123

Attachments: ND-MAP-vFinal.pdf; SOW-Northleaf-v1.docx; network-requirements.png

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwoodinference.com>, Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Carolyn Reid <carolyn@northleafdx.com>, Mike Hughes <mike.hughes@northleafdx.com>, procurement@northleafdx.com
Date: Sun, 29 Nov 2026 10:07:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Northleaf Diagnostics: implementation cadence & concierge nomination

Thanks for the summary, Jonas — happy to take primary concierge. A few clarifying questions before I book the kickoff: 

1) Pre-kickoff intake: can you drop the account-specific responses for the MAP (credentials, contact for EMR, expected ingestion cadence)? If not, I can run a short survey with Carolyn to capture.
2) Acceptance criteria: Ben, can you confirm the acceptance gates you expect in SOW (I saw milestone-based acceptance; would like explicit test cases for embeddings quality).
3) Network window: I assume the network diagram shows the egress IPs we should reserve — Tessa, can you validate our provisioning checklist against that PNG?

Proposed kickoff windows (60 min):
- Tue Dec 7, 10:00–11:00 PT
- Wed Dec 8, 14:00–15:00 PT

If Carolyn/Mike prefer a single, longer discovery to include engineering + security, we can extend to 90 min.

I will start an internal onboarding doc (owner: monica_patel) and drop the intake checklist to Drive (link to follow). I can also pre-populate runbooks for SSO and ingestion based on the SOW.

Monica Patel
Senior Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwoodinference.com

Adding a couple of commercial notes: 
- Legal: we've flagged three clauses (data residency, indemnity cap, export controls). I've asked their counsel to confirm 1–2 final items; expecting return by ~2026-12-10. If it slips beyond that, we may need to push provisioning by a week.
- Billing: proposed payment schedule is 50% upfront on signature, 50% at go-live. Carolyn / procurement — is that acceptable? If they require net-30 invoicing we will need a signed PO before provisioning.
- Acceptance: I've attached a slim SOW extract with explicit acceptance criteria for the embeddings tuning phase. Please review and confirm it maps to what Monica needs for QA.

I will stay on this thread until legal signs off and then step back.

Ben Carter

Thanks, Jonas — and hi Monica / Tessa. Happy to confirm the next steps from our side. Quick answers: 

- Technical contact: Mike Hughes (cc'd) will be the engineering lead for the project; he can share the EMR export schema and API credentials in a secure drive link.
- Procurement: we typically require net-30 and will raise a PO once legal confirms the final SOW. We can prioritise signature but expect PO within two weeks of signing.
- Timeline: Dec 6–10 kickoff works for us; prefer Tue Dec 7 10:00–11:30 PT for a 90-min session so we can include security and infra.
- Legal: we'll get the revised redlines back to Ben by Dec 9.

Monica — please put the intake survey link in your onboarding doc; we will complete it by EOD Dec 3.

Look forward to working with the team.

Carolyn Reid
VP Engineering, Northleaf Diagnostics
